title: Rabbi Menachma bar Zeira’

paragraphs: In Bereshit Rabbah 34:9, Rav Shalom reports in the name of Rabbi Menachma bar Zeira’. Hyman says that the name should undoubtedly read bar Zeira (זעירא).

notes.text: The source distinguishes זעירע, ending with ayin, from proposed זעירא, ending with alef. Its malformed Bereshit Rabbah locator and the abbreviation ל״ם remain unresolved; “without doubt” was not supported.

The saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 34:9 paragraph explicitly has Rav Shalom in the name of Menachma bar Zeira, ending זעירא with alef. This supplies a match alongside source פיילד-ט without proving that locator’s glyph history. Hyman’s supplied זעירע and proposed זעירא remain distinct. Full ובל״ם is retained unresolved: “without doubt” would require a conjectural ובל״ס reading, not an established expansion.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 893) gives Bereshit Rabbah 34:9 and ובל״ס, “without doubt,” where the supplied text has פיילד-ט and ובל״ם. The printed heading and first mention end in ayin (זעירע). Hyman proposes the spelling with final alef (זעירא), which is also the form in the consulted Bereshit Rabbah 34:9.
